definitions.gloss: to inquire, to make an inquiry, to contact for information
definitions.explanation: To contact a person, company, or organization to ask about something. Used for formal or semi-formal information requests, customer service inquiries, and official communications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{問|と}い{合|あ}わせて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please inquire at the counter for details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧、⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{問|と}い{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: I called the store to ask whether they had it in stock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{旅行会社|りょこうがいしゃ}→旅行会社：25965_ryokougaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{問|と}い{合|あ}わせた⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: When I inquired with the travel agency about the itinerary, I received a reply right away.

notes:
USAGE:
A polite, semi-formal verb commonly used in business and customer service contexts. Often appears in the set phrase お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧ (noun form, with honorific お) on websites and signs.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Ichidan verb. Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the person or organization contacted, and ⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧ or ⟦に{関|かん}して→に関して：06944_nikanshite⟧ for the topic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to inquire by phone
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to inquire by email
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to inquire at the counter
- お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: contact information
